Author: kaldigo
Name: Hotbar Bridge
Description: Configurable two-way regular/cross hotbar synchronization with shared slots, backups and capture.
Punchline: Inspect regular and cross hotbars for slot-based synchronization.
Changelog: 0.2.3: live-sync switch/status and resume; sensible window sizing and scrollable panels.

Author: kaldigo
Name: Job Setup
Description: Preview and apply current-class or all-class hotbar layouts and Wrath presets, with backups. Wrath must be disabled for configuration writes.
Punchline: Apply curated job hotbars and Wrath settings.
Changelog: 0.2.3: sensible window sizing and scrollable settings preview. Wrath must be disabled to apply settings.
